title.en: FreeVPN.my Performance Lab Launches with 42-Brand Database & Peak Metrics

description.zh: FreeVPN.my 宣布全面重构上线，首期收录 42 家主流机场品牌，完成 17 家晚高峰真实机器测速，致力于打造最可信的跨境网络选型指南。
description.en: FreeVPN.my officially goes live, tracking 42 proxy providers with raw peak-hour telemetry to eliminate marketing bias.
